channel.title: Open Source 3D & VFX Gems
channel.description: Open source 3D, VFX and video watch.

item.title: Industrial CG Platform 5.3.0
item.description: Industrial CG Platform 5.3.0 (Nov 23, 2026): free Blender fork aimed at film VFX (Deep EXR, overscan, light groups), now rebased on Blender 5.3.0. Cycles Deep EXR now handles the native World Volume, storing unbounded fog in a far-depth sample.

item.title: Better Gaussian Splat Importer 0.9.0 (KIRI Engine)
item.description: Better Gaussian Splat Importer 0.9.0 (Nov 25, 2026): free KIRI Engine add-on for Blender 5.3 that adds SOG, SPLAT, KSPLAT, compressed PLY and XGRIDS LCC/LCC2 splats to File > Import, converted locally into native Blender splats.

item.title: Shape Draw 0.1.0
item.description: Shape Draw 0.1.0 (Nov 25, 2026): GPL Blender extension, a pen tool for modelling: click out an outline (sharp or curved points) on the ground or any face, then pull it up with the mouse or an exact height, with bevel and a live boolean.

item.title: Lightwave Importer (BlenderLight) 2.0.0
item.description: Lightwave Importer 2.0.0 (published Nov 27, 2026 on extensions.blender.org): imports LightWave LWOB, LWO2 and LWO3 objects into Blender 5.2+: layers, subpatches, UVs, weight maps, morphs, Principled BSDF materials, skelegons to armatures.

item.title: Animated SOG (.asog)
item.description: Animated SOG (repo opened Nov 20, 2026, MIT): compact 4D Gaussian splat format (motion, SH, sound) with a Python encoder, a per-frame PLY flip-book pipeline and streaming PlayCanvas/three.js players. 180 PLY frames totalling 3.6 GB fit in 12.4 MB.

item.title: PERF-GS 1.0.0
item.description: PERF-GS 1.0.0 (Nov 26, 2026): EA SEED releases a BSD-3 Gaussian Splatting trainer written in Slang, running on Vulkan or D3D12 with no CUDA or PyTorch. A standalone hub runs COLMAP on a photo folder, trains and exports a PLY.

item.title: RG Houdini Bridge 1.0.0
item.description: RG Houdini Bridge 1.0.0 (Nov 25, 2026): GPL Blender extension that turns Houdini nodes and your own HDAs into live, non-destructive modifiers that update when the mesh changes, with no export step. Needs a local Houdini (tested with Indie, Windows, Blender 5.2).

item.title: FORMLYNX Inventor Import 1.1.1
item.description: FORMLYNX Inventor Import 1.1.1 (Nov 23, 2026): GPL Blender extension that imports Autodesk Inventor .iam assemblies and .ipt parts as meshes without Inventor: browser names, collections or empties, per-face colours, shared meshes, millimetre scale.

item.title: Pre-Selection Highlight 0.3.0
item.description: Pre-Selection Highlight 0.3.0: free Blender 5.0+ add-on that highlights vertices, edges and faces before you click in Edit Mode (loops and paths too) and colours proportional editing falloff, with a Maya-style radius hotkey. 0.3.0 adds topology symmetry (Nov 27 article).

item.title: Spirula Studio v2026.11.27
item.description: Spirula Studio v2026.11.27 (Nov 27, 2026): the GPL Gaussian Splatting trainer (Vulkan or CUDA, video → splat → mesh) improves meshing and low-texture surfaces, cuts VRAM, adds Voronoi partitioning, Y-up PLY export for SuperSplat and a live meshing preview.

item.title: Softimage Importer 0.3.0
item.description: Softimage Importer 0.3.0 (Nov 21, 2026): GPL Blender 5.2+ extension that imports Softimage files without Softimage: dotXSI 3.0–6.0 and native .scn/.emdl scenes and models. Geometry, materials, textures, skeletons as armatures, skinning and animation are converted.

item.title: Spline Maker 1.0.0
item.description: Spline Maker 1.0.0 (Nov 22, 2026): GPL Blender extension to draw and edit native Bézier curves the classic way: corners and arcs, vertex/segment/spline selection levels, gizmos, insert and weld vertices, and a live rectangle or circle profile swept along the spline.

item.title: Shrink Patch 1.13.0
item.description: Shrink Patch 1.13.0 (Nov 21, 2026): GPL Blender 5.3 add-on that places modelled details (bosses, rings, sockets, insets) on any surface with no visible seam: base wrapped on, normals transferred, KIT OPS-style automatic cuts for insets. Patches stay live and editable.

item.title: Lightning Emperor 0.1.1
item.description: Lightning Emperor 0.1.1 (Nov 21, 2026): GPL tools to composite CG behind actors shot on green or blue screen: camera distance, self-calibrating key, despill, marker tracking, shadows, matched grain. Python library + CLI, Blender 4.2+ add-on and MCP server.

item.title: OpenSplat4D 0.3
item.description: OpenSplat4D 0.3 (Nov 24, 2026): Unreal Engine 5.7–5.9 plugin for real-time 3D and 4D Gaussian splat rendering, now fully open source (Apache-2.0) with Chaos fracture and per-splat shadows. Reads PLY, SPZ, Spacetime Gaussians and Fudan's 4DGS.

item.title: SplatPilot
item.description: SplatPilot (featured Nov 23, 2026): GPL Blender extension that renders your scene from many views, trains a Gaussian splat locally on the GPU and brings it back into Blender. Coverage map, PLY/SOG/SPZ export; US$19 on Superhive, source included.

item.title: FashionCraft 0.2.2
item.description: FashionCraft (v0.2.2 on Nov 25, 2026): free MIT app written in Rust for 3D garment design in the Marvelous Designer vein: 2D patterns, sewing, GPU cloth-sim draping on an avatar, then export to Blender. Early alpha.

item.title: DBS_SceneProjection 0.9.0
item.description: DBS_SceneProjection 0.9.0 (Nov 24, 2026): MIT Nuke gizmo that builds a projection camera and geometry (floor, walls, primitives) from a single plate frame via ComfyUI (MoGe 2, SAM 3) and Blender, snapped to your camera track. Optional splat.

item.title: HueAtlas Lite 1.0.1
item.description: HueAtlas Lite (1.0.0 on Nov 19, 1.0.1 on Nov 21, 2026): GPL Blender add-on for palette-atlas texturing of low-poly kits. One material, one small image; you assign a swatch to faces, and changing a colour updates the image without touching the UVs.

item.title: Sculpt Transform Plus 0.1.0
item.description: Sculpt Transform Plus 0.1.0 (Nov 20, 2026): GPL Blender 5.3+ extension that keeps the Transform gizmo aligned with the pivot in Sculpt Mode. Pivot placed on the surface (Shift + right click), remembered per object, local axis locks and native undo.

item.title: Ensō Engine 1.1 beta
item.description: Ensō Engine 1.1 beta (announced Nov 21, 2026): free, open source Blender 5.3 build for anime and NPR (Windows). Cel shading with Light Select and For Each Light, ink lines and curvature in EEVEE, mask passes for the compositor.

item.title: OVV Orient Vector Viewer 1.0.2
item.description: OVV 1.0.2 (first public release, Nov 21, 2026): GPL Blender 5.2+ add-on that visualizes vectors and orientations in Geometry Nodes, Houdini style. Press V to wire the viewer; arrows, bases or cubes, plus quaternion and matrix math nodes.

item.title: BlendGit 2.0.0
item.description: BlendGit 2.0.0 (Nov 15, 2026): GPL Blender 5.0+ add-on that versions a .blend with Git from the sidebar. One file per object, mesh or material, so commits stay small; history with preview, single-item rollback, branches and GitHub push.

item.title: SplatCraft 0.1.3
item.description: SplatCraft 0.1.3 (Nov 22, 2026): local, MIT-licensed Gaussian splatting studio. Drop photos or videos: frames extracted and filtered, COLMAP alignment (with manual matches), Brush training with live preview, then export. Early prototype, tested on macOS.

item.title: PolyTailor 1.1.1
item.description: PolyTailor (published Nov 13, 1.1.1 on Nov 20, 2026): GPL Blender retopology and modeling extension for Edit Mode. Four tools on a W wheel: Build draws faces and quad strips, Fill caps holes with clean quads, plus Relax and Tweak; Topo mode snaps to the source model.

item.title: Sculpt UVs 1.0.0
item.description: Sculpt UVs 1.0.0 (17 Nov 2026): GPL Blender 5.x extension that paints UV seams with brushes right on the mesh. Draw, Erase, Move and Smooth brushes with live preview; only seam flags change, not the geometry or the UVs.

item.title: Hardcraft 0.11.0-alpha
item.description: CAD retopology add-on for Blender (Plasticity/STEP/OBJ). 0.11.0-alpha (13 Nov 2026) reworks splits (C key, ring split on tubes), adds a POINT mode, parts merge into one UV chart, a Japanese UI, STEP converter 1.2.7 and big speed gains.

item.title: QuickSplat 0.4.0
item.description: QuickSplat 0.4.0 (19 Nov 2026): 3D preview of Gaussian splats and point clouds on the space bar, in Windows Explorer (QuickLook plugin) and macOS Finder. Reads PLY, SPLAT, KSPLAT, SPZ and SOG offline. GPL-3.0.

item.title: Aztek 2.416
item.description: Aztek (repo created Nov 5, 2.416 on Nov 22, 2026): free MIT-0 3D app for Linux, Windows and macOS that follows studio DCC commands, hotkeys and menus: modeling, UVs, simulation, a path tracer, USD, MEL/Python scripts and .ma/.mb files.

item.title: AssetBridge
item.description: AssetBridge (Nov 16–17, 2026): local open-source (MIT) asset browser for Blender and Cinema 4D. It indexes your existing folders (Megascans, Poly Haven, kits, Gaussian splats…), shows a thumbnail grid and 3D previews, and sends an asset in one click with its materials.

item.title: Facetor 1.0.0
item.description: Facetor 1.0.0 (17 Nov 2026): GPL Blender extension that changes the segment count of a cylinder, hole, bevel or fillet (Alt+B + mouse wheel) while keeping the silhouette, even on messy CAD-export topology.

item.title: Maskwright Lite 1.0.0
item.description: Maskwright Lite 1.0.0 (13 Nov 2026): adds a node to Blender’s compositor that holds its own Bézier mask. Draw the shape over the image, set soft edge, invert and opacity, then output a mask or a cut-out. GPL.

item.title: MaxDrop 1.0.0
item.description: MaxDrop 1.0.0 (20 Nov 2026): GPL Blender extension, a fork of io_scene_max, that imports 3ds Max .max scenes without 3ds Max: meshes, UVs, V-Ray/Corona materials with textures, lights and cameras, even from the scene’s .zip.

item.title: Scan3D
item.description: Scan3D (19 Nov 2026): MIT Windows pipeline that turns photos or a phone video into a Gaussian splat, a textured mesh and a collision mesh in one coordinate system, via Spirula Studio and COLMAP, with a web UI and no cloud.

item.title: mPainter 0.9.2
item.description: mPainter 0.9.2 (16 Nov 2026): GPL texture painting app built on Blender with a Qt workspace. It paints PBR with layers and masks, imports your Blender node materials and generates wear masks (curvature, AO).

item.title: Pinvas 1.0.1
item.description: Pinvas 1.0.1 (16 Nov 2026): free GPL Blender add-on that opens a reference board in the 3D View sidebar: paste, pack, greyscale, set opacity, hex color picker; the board is saved in the .blend.

item.title: Frankensplat
item.description: Frankensplat (Nov 2026): trains Gaussian splats in the browser with WebGPU from a COLMAP reconstruction, no install needed. Free, commercial use allowed (not open source).

item.title: CryptoRay 0.6.1
item.description: CryptoRay 0.6.1 (16 Nov 2026): a GPL Blender add-on for Cycles that gives every object seen through glass or reflected in chrome its own Cryptomatte ID, distorted like the beauty, in an EXR readable by Nuke or any Cryptomatte reader.

item.title: GrimTopo 1.0.1
item.description: GrimTopo 1.0.1 (13 Nov 2026): a free (GPL) retopology add-on by Grim Edge Studio. Draw strips, patches or tubes on a sculpt or scan and they become quads; Smart Fill suggests hole fills, with relax, mirror and a template head.

item.title: Splat Repair 0.1.0
item.description: Splat Repair 0.1.0 (16 Nov 2026): an Apache 2.0 Gaussian splat editor with a repair brush: paint over what should go and the surface is rebuilt (CPU Fast Fill, LaMa Deep Fill). Clone stamp, lasso, floater clean-up; PLY, SPLAT, SPZ.

item.title: Harappa 1.2.1
item.description: Harappa 1.2.1 (16 Nov 2026): a GPL Blender add-on that turns terrain into an anime-style meadow in EEVEE (painted grass, flowers, trees, cel-shaded sky). 1.2 adds ponds, streams, waterfalls, rocks and weather; 1.2.1 makes the water flow again.

item.title: SculptForge 0.13.7
item.description: SculptForge 0.13.7 (18 Nov 2026): a free GPL 3D sculpting app. The 0.13 series brings shadows and ambient occlusion to the PBR view; 0.13.7 adds circle and ellipse shapes for Mask, Select and Cut.

item.title: Texel Kit 1.0.1
item.description: Texel Kit 1.0.1 (11 Nov 2026): a GPL Blender add-on to measure and unify texel density (object, faces or UV islands), with presets, an eyedropper, a heatmap and a reversible checker. For Blender 4.2 and later.

item.title: LayerCake 1.1.1
item.description: LayerCake 1.1.1 (11 Nov 2026): a GPL add-on for Blender’s compositor that rebuilds the Combined image from render passes (Render Layers or multilayer EXR) in an editable node setup, with Cycles, EEVEE and Cryptomatte. For Blender 4.2–5.3.

item.title: OpenReview 2.0.0
item.description: OpenReview 2.0.0 (4 Nov 2026): MIT-licensed VFX dailies viewer (sequences, EXR passes, plate/comp comparison, NaN checks) that moves to a native Rust engine, much faster for contact sheets and scrubbing.

item.title: Gaffer 1.7.7
item.description: Gaffer 1.7.7 (12 Nov 2026): the open source (BSD) node-based app for VFX lookdev, lighting and automation adds a Collect mode to DeepMerge and compact columns in the Light Editor, after the paint tool and MCP interface of 1.7.5–1.7.6.

item.title: Mask Tools (Bookyakuno)
item.description: Mask Tools, a free Blender add-on by Bookyakuno, got an update (spotted 12 Nov 2026): sculpt masks saved as combinable vertex groups, cavity, convexity or AO masks, blur, contrast and curves, all in one Sculpt panel.

item.title: BakeDown 1.6.0
item.description: BakeDown 1.6.0 (11 Nov 2026): GPL Blender add-on that turns a heavy mesh (AI, scan, sculpt) into a light asset: simplification, baking the original's PBR textures, LODs and export to Unity, Unreal or glTF, with the original kept intact.

item.title: Smart Tris to Quads 4.1.0
item.description: Smart Tris to Quads 4.1.0 (11 Nov 2026): a smarter Alt+J for triangulated meshes (CAD STL): quads follow the surface's real grid and run through bevels, and a Full Quad mode leaves only quads without moving the original vertices.

item.title: Version Notes 0.1.0
item.description: Version Notes 0.1.0 (5 Nov 2026): GPL extension that adds a note (and the author) to each incremental save, via Save As or Save Incremental With Note, collected in a text file next to the .blend files so you can see what changed.

item.title: Sculpt Join 0.1.0
item.description: Sculpt Join 0.1.0 (10 Nov 2026): GPL extension that temporarily joins visible meshes (body, clothes, accessories) so you can sculpt them as one piece, then writes the new positions back into each original, modifiers and Multires intact.

item.title: Tessera – Mosaic & Tile Studio 1.0.0
item.description: Tessera 1.0.0 (9 Nov 2026): GPL Geometry Nodes studio for mosaics and tiles, 94 styles (Roman, Byzantine, zellige, azulejos, terrazzo…), layered ceramic material, chips and missing tiles tweakable live.

item.title: matte
item.description: matte (released 10 Nov 2026): MIT node-based compositor running in the browser on the GPU: chroma keying with spill suppression, light wrap, grading, keyframes, scopes and shot export, with nothing to install.

item.title: Blender2UE Mesh Bridge 1.0.0
item.description: Blender2UE Mesh Bridge 1.0.0 (11 Nov 2026): GPL add-on that sends a Blender scene to Unreal 5.6–5.8 with exact positions, rotations and scales, either via copy-paste or via FBX export + an auto-placement script with one material per mesh.

item.title: Sundari 0.1.0
item.description: Sundari 0.1.0 (10 Nov 2026): spectral path tracer and look-dev workspace for Apple Silicon Macs, free but not open source: OpenUSD, MaterialX, OpenPBR, dispersion and a Blender live-link. First public proof of concept.

item.title: Narwhal 3D 0.4.12
item.description: Narwhal 3D 0.4.12 (9 Nov 2026): free GPL, command-driven NURBS CAD for precise curves, smooth surfaces and solids in four views. This release adds TracePicture (tracing an image into curves) to the Linux and Windows packages.

item.title: Max Spline Tools 1.5.2
item.description: Max Spline Tools 1.5.2 (4 Nov 2026): GPL extension bringing the 3ds Max editable-spline workflow to Blender: Bezier drawing with snapping, interactive extrude, outline, fillet and chamfer, spline booleans and parametric primitives.

item.title: Texture Relinker 0.1.2
item.description: Texture Relinker 0.1.2 (6 Nov 2026): GPL extension that finds a .blend’s missing (pink) textures even when renamed or converted, by scoring file-name similarity; you check every match before relinking.

item.title: Kanvaz 9.8.4
item.description: Kanvaz 9.8.4 (10 Nov 2026): MIT infinite-canvas reference board for 3D/VFX artists, fully offline: 3D models, images, GIFs, video, audio and annotations. This release moves to Electron 45 and updates dependencies.

item.title: Wanderer CAD 2.96.122
item.description: Wanderer CAD 2.96.122 (9 Nov 2026): GPL add-on bringing a CAD-style workflow to Blender (command line, snaps, dimensions, layers) and adding Rhino-style SubD modeling: box, loft, sweep, revolve, creases and edit tools.

item.title: Intelligent UV Mapping 0.36.0
item.description: Intelligent UV Mapping 0.36.0 (8 Nov 2026): GPL add-on for automatic UV unwrapping — curvature-driven seams, island merging, even texel density. New release adds topological seam completion and a Blender-only edition.

item.title: Sculptools: Layers 1.0.0
item.description: Sculptools: Layers 1.0.0 (published 1 Nov 2026): GPL extension adding non-destructive sculpt layers to Blender — per-layer opacity, Morph Brush, mirroring, Multires support and baking to shape keys.

item.title: OpenBillow 0.5.4
item.description: OpenBillow 0.5.4 (8 Nov 2026): GPL GPU smoke, fire and liquid sim add-on (NVIDIA Warp) for Blender 4.5+ — OpenVDB cache, FLIP/APIC with spray/foam/bubbles, and built-in starter presets.

item.title: Comp 0.2.0 beta
item.description: Comp 0.2.0 beta (7 Nov 2026): free node-based compositor (Windows, macOS, Linux) — 3D projections from an FBX/Alembic camera, local AI keying (CCkey, AutoMatte) and nine 3DE lens models.

item.title: LichtFeld Training for Blender 0.1.0
item.description: LichtFeld Training for Blender 0.1.0 (2 Nov 2026): GPL extension for Blender 5.3 that builds a camera rig, captures the scene (Cycles or EEVEE) and trains a navigable splat without opening LichtFeld Studio.

item.title: StarLightGS
item.description: StarLightGS (6 Nov 2026): MIT CoSTAR plugin for Unreal Engine 5.7+ that writes Gaussian splats into the GBuffer — native relighting and shadows (VSM), no proxy mesh.

item.title: Gaussian Splat Patch 0.2.0
item.description: Gaussian Splat Patch 0.2.0 (4 Nov 2026): GPL Blender 5.3+ extension that converts a mesh into splats with no training (Cycles bake, 3 lighting modes including Light from Scan via Spirula).

item.title: Maya Workflow Kit 0.13.0
item.description: Maya Workflow Kit 0.13.0 (7 Nov 2026): GPL Blender 5.2 LTS extension — Maya 2027-style Smart Bevel, Universal Manipulator on components, Connect Tool and tear-off Graph/UV editor windows.

item.title: Nukify 0.11.1
item.description: Nukify 0.11.1 (7 Nov 2026): GPL open-source node compositor powered by Blender — drag-and-drop images/sequences onto the graph (Read nodes) and a new Import material context menu.

item.title: Continuum Flow 0.4.0
item.description: Continuum Flow 0.4.0 (11 Oct 2026): GPL GPU OpenCL smoke/fire sim add-on for Blender 5.0+ (AMD/NVIDIA), up to ~60× faster than the native solver; keyframable UI.

item.title: SuperSplat for Blender 0.1.0
item.description: SuperSplat for Blender 0.1.0 (5 Nov 2026): MIT PlayCanvas extension for Blender 5.3+ — import a SuperSplat scene by link (SOG/SSOG, attribution) and publish a selected splat back.

item.title: OM3D Atlas 0.4.3
item.description: OM3D Atlas 0.4.3 (6 Nov 2026): GPL extension that packs a character’s texture sets into atlases (texel density, UDIM, Max Sets); Revert now also deletes the generated textures.

item.title: Mat-Baker 1.1.0
item.description: Mat-Baker 1.1.0 (4 Nov 2026): GPL Blender 4.2+ add-on that bakes a procedural Principled BSDF material into a PBR pack in one click (Unreal/Unity/glTF presets, ORM, batch).

item.title: Paint a plate 1.11.1
item.description: Paint a plate 1.11.1 (3 Nov 2026): Apache-2.0 ComfyUI pack (AInVFX) to paint on a plate’s first frame (erase, add, relight); edits propagate through the shot, EXR/OCIO export.

item.title: Maya Scene IO 1.1.0
item.description: Maya Scene IO 1.1.0 (4 Nov 2026): import/export .ma/.mb in Blender without Maya; 1.1 fixes Maya matrices/pivots, animation tangents, units and animated groups.

item.title: OpenFilmic 1.0.0
item.description: OpenFilmic 1.0.0 (5 Nov 2026): a GPL Blender 5.2+ Compositor node packing film emulations, lens effects, animated grain and borders — 28 presets included.

item.title: CurioMesh 0.9.6
item.description: CurioMesh 0.9.6 (5 Nov 2026): free GPL auto-retopo for Blender 3.6–5.2 — all-quads part by part with camera checks; Texture Sets bake across multiple atlases.

item.title: StableGen 0.5.0
item.description: StableGen 0.5.0 (4 Nov 2026): GPL Blender add-on for AI texturing/generation via ComfyUI installable inside Blender, consistent multi-view projection, LATO.2 remesh and Make Solid.

item.title: OGC 3D Tiles Streaming 0.5.1
item.description: OGC 3D Tiles Streaming 0.5.1 (4 Nov 2026): MIT Blender add-on (Iconem) streaming meshes, point clouds and KHR Gaussian splats via cesium-native, with clips and overlays, EEVEE/Cycles.

item.title: splat2stl
item.description: splat2stl (repo dated 1 Nov 2026): MIT tool turning a Gaussian splat .ply into a watertight STL plus colored OBJ via pure-PyTorch silhouette carving, ~10 s on an 8 GB GPU.

item.title: Blender 5.3 — native Gaussian splats
item.description: Blender developers' post from Oct 30, 2026: 5.3 imports Gaussian splats (.ply, .spz, USD) as a point cloud type, editable in Geometry Nodes and rendered by EEVEE, Workbench and Cycles, with relighting still experimental.

item.title: Spirula Render 0.13.1
item.description: GPL render engine for Blender 5.3+ that renders Gaussian splats with Spirula Studio's rasterizer, with relighting and splat-to-splat shadows. Versions 0.11 to 0.13 (Nov 3, 2026) add flares, filters and vintage lenses from Vintage Click.

item.title: Photocraft VFX 0.4.0
item.description: Apache-2.0 layer-based image editor built like Nuke: 32-bit scene-linear ACEScg, OpenColorIO, multichannel EXR export and Nuke script output. 0.4.0 (Nov 4, 2026) adds a Nuke-style OCIO viewer, viewer LUTs and an input colour space setting.

item.title: Unity Gaussian Splatting 2.0.0
item.description: Aras Pranckevičius's MIT plugin for rendering Gaussian splats in Unity. 2.0.0 (Nov 2, 2026) loads .ply and .spz files (including SPZ 4) directly with no conversion, sorts several intersecting splats globally and drops the editing tools.

item.title: SimpleStep Importer 1.5.3
item.description: GPL add-on (Nov 2, 2026) that imports STEP CAD assemblies into Blender 5.2+ without freezing the UI: background C++ conversion, part names and hierarchy, instances, colours and adaptive meshing. Windows x64 only for now.

item.title: SplatThumb 0.4.0
item.description: MIT tool for Windows 10/11 that shows Explorer thumbnails for Gaussian splat .ply files (INRIA and SuperSplat compressed PLY), with an adjustable view per file. Version 0.4.0, Nov 1, 2026.

item.title: Perspective Match 1.0.1
item.description: GPL extension for Blender 5.2 released Nov 1, 2026: draw perspective lines on a photo and the camera solves live (auto line detection on architecture), handy for matching 3D into a still plate.

item.title: Devil Designer 0.11.0
item.description: GPL add-on for making clothes in Blender: 2D patterns in centimetres, sewing, then draping on the character with cloth simulation. Version 0.11.0 (Oct 31, 2026) adds calibrated fabric presets and per-piece settings.

item.title: Sabercat 1.0.0
item.description: Apache-2.0 GPU engine for Gaussian splats (Vulkan 1.3, Slang/C++): real-time rendering, gradients for training and relighting with ray-traced shadows, plus a viewer and a layer editor with PLY/GLB export. Version 1.0.0, Oct 29, 2026.

item.title: PlayCanvas — Particle Blast (splats)
item.description: New example in the MIT PlayCanvas engine (added Nov 2, 2026): a Gaussian splat scene turns into 2 million WebGPU physics particles that burn, pour or shatter, colliding with a voxel grid derived from the splat.

item.title: Gaussian-Splat-Lite
item.description: Apache-2.0 Gaussian splat renderer for Three.js (WebGPU/WebGL2, PLY, SPZ, SOG, RAD, streaming LOD). Since Nov 2, 2026 its RAD converter supports an SH codebook, making SH3 files over 55% smaller.

item.title: Image Region Transform 1.0.4
item.description: GPL add-on that selects a pixel region in the Image/UV Editor (box or polyline) to move, rotate, warp or copy it across textures, without touching UVs and with native undo. Version 1.0.4 released Nov 1, 2026.

item.title: EasyMold 1.0.1
item.description: Free add-on that builds 3D-printable molds around an object: direct or silicone molds, parting surface, keys, pour holes, vents, splitting for the print bed and STL/3MF export. Published Oct 30, 2026.

item.title: Arkedia SKP Bridge 0.3.3
item.description: GPL Blender extension that imports and exports SketchUp .skp files without SketchUp: components as instances, tags as collections, scenes as cameras, and Bonsai IFC attributes kept. Windows, Blender 5.2. Version 0.3.3 released Oct 30, 2026.

item.title: Fused Zip-NeRF
item.description: MIT reimplementation of Zip-NeRF in handwritten fused CUDA kernels for the NeRFICG framework: per author Florian Hahlbohm, 6 to 7 times faster training and 10 times faster rendering at the same quality. Released Oct 30, 2026.

item.title: Ucupaint 3.0
item.description: Blender’s GPL texture layer system skips 2.5: a UI centred on the layer list with a base layer, separate Height and Vector Displacement channels, adjustment layers, spherical and cylindrical decals, and a reworked bake target system. Released Oct 23, 2026.

item.title: Ichno 1.0.4
item.description: GPL extension that turns your scene into PDF/SVG technical drawings in one click: projected and isometric views, automatic dimensions, title block, bill of materials, one sheet per collection. Version 1.0.4 (Oct 31, 2026) puts each drawing in its own folder.

item.title: Black Hole Studio 1.0.0
item.description: GPL extension that adds a physically based black hole: light bent by general relativity, accretion disk with Doppler beaming and redshift, jets, scene objects lensed behind it. Fast mode for Cycles/EEVEE or exact OSL mode, six presets. Published Oct 28, 2026.

item.title: PlateLock
item.description: MIT ComfyUI node pack: LTX-2.3 generates the effect (explosion, portal…) and PlateLock composites it onto the original plate the VFX way, keeping every pixel the effect doesn’t touch bit-identical. Published Oct 29, 2026.

item.title: noodlebin 0.1.1
item.description: GPL extension that copies Blender node trees (shader, Geometry Nodes, compositor) as text: paste them on noodlebin.art to view and share as a link, then paste them back into any .blend with values, frames and groups intact. Published Oct 25, 2026.
